difficulty_rationale: This bundle spans full lifecycle APIs, idempotent and transactional provisioning, auditing, service-account/token-rotation flows, bootstrap identity, federation support, and provider health/metrics across auth, API, provisioning, storage, and observability modules.
integration_surface_rationale: Touches 4+ modules including src/oidc/, src/api/middleware/, src/api/routes/, src/idn/, src/obs/, plus integration test harness and migrations.
